::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 23d [1864?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Columbia University Library, New York: Samuels, J.H. Collection
:::

My dear Madam,
I send herewith a copy of [Heartsease leaves](cmy_books/cmybook_45.qmd), but I am afraid I must ask you to return it. I had some copies once sold for a bazaar, but they are all gone now, except one or two for home consumption of which I send one. 

I am glad that the [Christian names](cmy_books/cmybook_48.qmd) gave you any amusement

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** This letter evidently predates the republication of *Last Heartsease Leaves* as 'Lost Heartsease Leaves' in *Events of the Month* (January 1865).
